description: Configure temporary voice channel creation settings here

content.name: channelID
content.description: Set the channel here where users have to join to create their temp-channel

content.name: category
content.description: You can set a category here in which the new channel should be created

content.name: channelname_format
content.description: Change the format of the channel name here

params.name: number
params.description: The current number of the channel

content.name: timeout
content.description: Set a timeout here in which the bot should wait before deleting the voice channel (in seconds)

content.name: publicChannels
content.description: If enabled, new temp channels start public (synced with category). If disabled, channels start private (only the creator can join).

content.name: allowUserToChangeMode
content.description: If enabled the user has the permission to change the access-mode of the voice channel

content.name: privateBypassRoles
content.description: Roles that can always join and see private temporary channels, regardless of who created them.

content.name: allowUserToChangeName
content.description: If enabled the user has the permission to change the name and settings of the voice channel via both, the Discord-integrated menus and the corresponding /-commands

content.name: create_no_mic_channel
content.description: If enabled the bot will create a separate text channel for each voice channel, visible only to users in the voice channel. Note: Discord now has built-in text-in-voice channels, so this is usually not needed.

content.name: noMicChannelMessage
content.default: Welcome to your no-mic-channel - you can only see this channel if you are in the connected voicechat
content.description: You can set a message here that should be send in the no-mic-channel when created

content.name: useNoMic
content.description: If enabled the settings menu will be sent into the no-mic-channel. If no-mic-channels aren't enabled, the menu will instead be sent to Discord's integrated text-in-voice channels

content.name: settingsChannel
content.description: You can set a channel here in which the settings menu should be created. Leave this field empty, if you don't want to use this feature.

content.name: send_dm
content.description: Should the bot send a direct message to a user when a new channel is created for them?

content.name: dm
content.default: I have created and moved you to your new voice-channel - have fun ^^
content.description: The direct message content sent to the user when their temporary channel is created.

content.name: notInChannel
content.default: You have to be in your temp-channel to do this
content.description: This message gets sent to a user who tries to edit their channel while not being in it.

content.name: modeSwitched
content.default: The access-mode of your channel has been switched to %mode%
content.description: This message gets sent to a user, after they changed the mode of their channel

content.name: userAdded
content.default: the user %user% has been added to your channel. They can now access it whenever they like to
content.description: This message gets sent to a user, after they added an user to their channel

content.name: userRemoved
content.default: the user %user% has been removed from your channel. They can no longer access it, while your channel is private
content.description: This message gets sent to a user, after they removed an user from their channel

content.name: listUsers
content.default: Here is a list of all the users that have access to your channel: %users%
content.description: The message to be sent when a user requests a list of users with access to their channel.

content.name: channelEdited
content.description: The message to be sent when a user edits their channel.

content.name: edit-error
content.default: An error occurred while editing your channel. One or more of your settings could not be applied. This could be due to missing permissions or an invalid value
content.description: The message sent when a channel edit fails.

content.name: settingsMessage
content.default: Change the Settings of your temporary channel here
content.description: Set the message that should get send in the channel specified above to let the users change the settings of their temp-channels

content.name: enableMaxActiveChannels
content.description: If enabled, the bot will limit the number of temporary channels that can exist at the same time.

content.name: maxActiveChannels
content.description: Maximum number of temp channels that can exist at the same time.

content.name: maxActiveChannelsMessage
content.default: ⚠️ The maximum number of temporary channels has been reached. Please try again later.
content.description: This message is sent via DM when a user tries to create a temp channel but the limit has been reached.

content.name: enableArchiving
content.description: If enabled, empty temp channels will be moved to an archive category instead of being deleted. Channels are restored when the creator rejoins the trigger channel.

content.name: archiveCategory
content.description: Category where archived temp channels are moved to. Make this category hidden from regular users.

content.name: archiveDeleteAfterHours
content.description: Hours after which archived channels are permanently deleted. Set to 0 to never auto-delete. Default: 168 (7 days).
